(Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the station includes a processor programmed to receive operator acknowledgment input, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time interval, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor.
